						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_ag_operation_total
					has_variable = zg361_p3_ag_operation_used
					has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
					has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
					has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_deferred
				}
				var:zg361_p3_ag_operation_used < var:zg361_p3_ag_operation_total
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m309_debt_status }
					var:zg361_p3_m309_debt_status != 1
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ag_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ag_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ag_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ag_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ag_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = 4
			OPERATION_ID = 309
			CHOICE = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_ag_operation_used add = 1 }
			remove_variable = zg361_p3_m309_debt_settled_by
			remove_variable = zg361_p3_m309_debt_settled_cycle
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_state value = 4 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_mechanism value = 309 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_due_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_due_cycle add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_status value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_audit_state value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_performance_sink value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_debt_consumer_status value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_portfolio_deferred value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_deferred_cleanup_status value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_status value = 1 }

		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ag_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ag_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_ag_operation_total
						has_variable = zg361_p3_ag_operation_used
						has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_open_n
						has_variable = zg361_p3_policy_debt_settled_n
						has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_deferred
					}
					var:zg361_p3_ag_operation_used < var:zg361_p3_ag_operation_total
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m309_debt_status }
						var:zg361_p3_m309_debt_status != 1
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_last_red_code value = 3093 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED; no receipt/business/resource write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ag_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ag_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ag_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_p3_m309_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
